subject: Aligning demo deep-dive + evaluation kickoff (prompt handoff)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@quantifyhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning demo deep-dive + evaluation kickoff (prompt handoff)

Hi Lena —

Great talking with you earlier — thanks for walking through QuantifyHealth's ingestion and labeling workflows. Per our discovery, it sounds like the two priority items for next week are: (1) a technical deep-dive/demo for the engineering and data teams, and (2) an evaluation kickoff to align on success criteria, trial timeline, and sample prompts/evals.

Suggested next steps from our side:
- Schedule a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive (include engineer(s) + data lead).
- Kick off a short evaluation window (2–4 weeks typical) with clear success metrics and a prompt set we can use to baseline quality.

I have two slots open next week (all PT):
- Wed 2027-04-28 10:00–11:15 PT
- Thu 2027-04-29 13:00–14:15 PT

If those don't work, tell me your availability and we’ll iterate. For the evaluation kickoff, could you please share:
1) the primary success criteria you care about (latency, accuracy on clinical entities, hallucination tolerance, cost thresholds, etc.),
2) a small seed prompt set (5–10 examples) and expected outputs, and
3) any security/compliance contacts we should include (for SOC2 evidence or an architectural review).

I’ve attached our short eval playbook (redwood_eval_playbook_v2.pdf) — it outlines a lightweight trial plan, typical metrics we track, and role responsibilities. I'll loop in Marissa from CS and Vivek from engineering once we lock a time so we can bring the right folks.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood_eval_playbook_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 360KB)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@quantifyhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@quantifyhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 12:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Aligning demo deep-dive + evaluation kickoff (prompt handoff)

Thanks Karthik — really helpful summary and appreciate the playbook.

Both Daniel (security) and our data lead will want to join the deep-dive. We’re based on ET, so your slots translate to: Wed 13:00–14:15 ET and Thu 16:00–17:15 ET. The Wed slot looks promising for our engineers. Can you hold Wed 2027-04-28 13:00–14:15 ET?

A few asks from our side before the kickoff:
- Can you share a short SOC2 summary and any data retention / access controls (we attach our security addendum in case you need to review).
- Procurement will want a draft SOW and an outline of what the trial includes (data access, support level, deliverables).
- I’ll prepare an initial success criteria list and a small CSV of prompts — see attached sample (Quantify_Prompts_v1.csv).

I’ve attached our QH security addendum (QH_security_addendum.xlsx) so you can see their standard language; Daniel is cc’d to pick the right person for a deeper security call if needed.

If Wed works for you, confirm and I’ll send a calendar invite to everyone.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of ML Platforms
QuantifyHealth
lena.ortiz@quantifyhealth.com

Attachment: QH_security_addendum.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 48KB)

To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@quantifyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning demo deep-dive + evaluation kickoff (prompt handoff)

Lena — thanks, Wed 2027-04-28 10:00–11:15 PT (13:00–14:15 ET) works for us. I’ve held the slot on my calendar.

Marissa (Customer Success) and Vivek (Solutions Engineering) are looped in — Marissa will own the evaluation logistics and Playbook milestones; Vivek will lead the technical deep-dive on architecture, integration points, and performance expectations.

Quick agenda for the deep-dive (60–75m):
- 10m — introductions and objectives
- 20m — architecture & integration (how QuantifyHealth data would be sent, minimal data schemas, access controls)
- 20m — live demo: inference workflows, prompt engineering recommendations, caching/batching options
- 10–15m — evaluation plan & next steps (trial timeline, who owns what, measurement hooks)

Attachments I’m sharing: draft SOW for the trial (SOW_draft_QH.docx) and our eval playbook you already have. Marissa — can you own sending a short mutual action plan doc after the call?

On SOC2: our SOC2 Summary and data-retention overview are in our security folder; I’ll have our security team send a formal package if Daniel wants one.

See you on Wed.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_draft_QH.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 95KB)

Confirmed — I’ve sent the calendar invite for Wed 2027-04-28 13:00–14:15 ET (Google Meet link included). Attendees from our side: Lena (ML Platforms), Daniel (Security), Priya (Data Lead), and Anna (Product).

Initial success criteria we want to measure during the trial (high level):
- Clinical entity extraction F1 >= 0.88 on our seed prompt set
- Mean inference latency per request < 450ms over representative payloads
- False positive rate for hallucinated entities < 3% on blinded review
- Integration stability: less than 2 incidents per week during the trial window

Sample prompt examples (from attached CSV):
- "Extract patient medications and doses from clinical note: <note>"
- "Normalize free-text diagnosis to ICD-10 codes: <text>"

We’ll bring the seed CSV to the call and share more context on labels and evaluation procedure. Daniel — if you want a separate security technical call, happy to schedule after Wed.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Lena
Head of ML Platforms, QuantifyHealth
